articles.title: Qatar LNG ship nears Hormuz in attempt to exit strait - Data
articles.expand: A liquefied natural gas ship loaded in Qatar early last month is making its way toward the Strait of Hormuz, potentially marking the first visible effort to evacuate the critical waterway since July. According to ship-tracking data, the Al Marrouna vessel approached the strait on Monday, identifying Port Qasim in Pakistan as its next destination, with an expected arrival on Thursday. It was unclear whether the ship would continue its journey through Hormuz, an uncommon move following an attack on another Qatari gas tanker nearly two months earlier.
